description:
A group of young people united for the sake of scientific development and the democratization of astronomy for children.

Our goal is simple: a solution to a complex problem.

Bringing the future into our own hands is not just about evolving our way of thinking; it is also about making knowledge accessible to the public.

An idea held by a single individual is just one idea; within a group, it becomes a seed that germinates into a future of peace.
